title: SQL Server integrated: lag reads healthy while the destination is empty

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27, integrated, 450 tables, continuous

symptom: The event log showed "CDC extraction IN_PROGRESS ... Zero snapshots are pending ... lag 5 seconds" for about five hours. The destination tables had 0 rows against 3 in the source. DESCRIBE HISTORY showed MERGE versions with numTargetRowsInserted 0. A stop and start didn't change it.
cause: Not established. The grant was added after a failed first start, and earlier records show state kept from a failed start.
effect: The pipeline looks healthy while no rows arrive.
fix: Count the destination rows and read DESCRIBE HISTORY (see the checks in engine-sqlserver.md). Rerun with the grant in place before create.
notes: One run. The 10-table rerun is not yet recorded.
